title: Rep2Text: Decoding Full Text from a Single LLM Token Representation
abstract: arXiv:2511.06571v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models represent text as hidden numerical patterns, but what information these representations actually contain remains a mystery. Can we recover the original text from just one of them? In this paper, we introduce Rep2Text, a method designed to answer this question by reconstructing text from a single hidden representation. We find that these representations preserve much more information than we might expect. For short texts of about 16 words, Rep2Text can recover roughly half of the original words while preserving their overall meaning. As the text gets longer, recovering the exact wording becomes harder, but the main ideas can still be recovered. These findings offer a new way to understand what language models store internally and highlight potential privacy risks, as hidden representations may reveal parts of the original input.

translated_title: Rep2Text：从单个LLM词元表示中解码完整文本
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型将文本表示为隐藏的数值模式，但这些表示实际包含什么信息仍然是一个谜。我们能否仅凭其中一个表示恢复出原始文本？在本文中，我们提出了Rep2Text，这是一种旨在通过从单个隐藏表示重建文本来回答这一问题的方法。我们发现这些表示保留的信息远比我们预期的要多。对于约16个单词的短文本，Rep2Text能够恢复大约一半的原始单词，同时保留其整体含义。随着文本变长，恢复确切的措辞变得更加困难，但主要思想仍然可以被恢复。这些发现为理解语言模型内部存储了什么提供了新的途径，并凸显了潜在的隐私风险，因为隐藏表示可能会泄露原始输入的部分内容。
tldr: 提出Rep2Text方法，证明仅凭LLM的单个隐藏表示即可重建原始文本（短文本可恢复约一半单词及整体含义），揭示了隐藏表示蕴含的丰富信息及其潜在的隐私泄露风险。
en_tdlr: Proposes Rep2Text, a method demonstrating that original text can be reconstructed from a single LLM hidden representation—recovering about half the words of short texts while preserving meaning—revealing how much information these representations store and highlighting potential privacy risks.
